screen.mc_tiny_tweak.tweaks.compact_heal: Past 20 hearts, shows two bars instead of rows of hearts. Health comes in layers of 20 hearts, each its own color. The thin bar shows every layer, golden hearts and what is missing in black. The thick bar shows the top layer over the one below.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.tweaks.fullbright.t: Lights everything like night vision, even caves at night. Key: %s
notice.mc_tiny_tweak.attributes.already_: Your own attribute edits are already loaded
notice.mc_tiny_tweak.inventory_presets.k: New world: you got the starter kit.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.tweaks.show_armor.t: Off hides armor on players and shows a bar above their name instead: one segment per piece, in its material's color
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.item_editor.name: Custom name
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.item_editor.codes_h: Use & codes: &c red, &l bold, &o italic, &r reset, &#FF8800 hex, && for &
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.item_editor.applied: Sent the /item command for your hand
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.item_editor.operato: Operator permission (level 2) is required to apply with /item
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.item_editor.no_play: No player to give the item to

controls.mc_tiny_tweak.key_search.toolti: Click, then press a key or mouse button to show every bind using it. Escape clears.
controls.mc_tiny_tweak.mode.tablet.toolt: Break with Q, place with E and hold left click to freelook.
controls.mc_tiny_tweak.mode.mouse.toolti: Break with left click, place with right click and hold middle click to freelook.
controls.mc_tiny_tweak.unbind_extras.too: Unbind every keybind that the mod's saved defaults do not list.
controls.mc_tiny_tweak.unbind_extras.con: Unbind %s keybinds that your saved defaults do not list? Reset restores them.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.enabled.tooltip: Lets an AI agent on this computer play this game through the Model Context Protocol. Only programs on this computer with the token can connect.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.state.t: Position, health, inventory, what the crosshair targets and nearby players.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.screens: Lets the agent see the screen.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.chatRea: Lets the agent read chat, including command feedback.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.chatSen: Lets the agent send chat messages as you. Needs take over.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.command: Lets the agent run commands as you, with or without take over.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.input.t: Lets the agent hold keys, look around, pick hotbar slots and close menus. While it plays, the game does not pause when the window loses focus.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.bariton: Lets the agent give Baritone commands, such as mining or walking somewhere, when Baritone is installed. Needs take over.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.copy.tooltip: Copies a Claude Code command that connects an agent to this game. It contains the token, so keep it private.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.new_token.toolt: Makes a new token. Agents set up with the old one stop working.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.new_token.confi: Agents set up with the current token will have to be set up again.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.feature.takeOve: Lets the agent take sole control: your keyboard and mouse stop working in game until it lets go or you take control back here. Needed for sending chat, Baritone and joining worlds.
Lets the agent list, join and leave servers and singleplayer worlds, even from the title screen. Joining and leaving needs take over.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.control.tooltip: Who plays right now. Switch to Player to take control back from the agent.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.show_actions.to: Shows every action the agent takes in chat. The agent does not see these lines.
notice.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.took_over: An agent took over. Open the mod menu > MCP to take back control.
notice.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.released: The agent gave control back to you.
notice.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.player_took_bac: You took back control from the agent.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.freecam.tooltip: Fly the camera away from your player. Also on while an agent has taken over. Key: %s
hud.mc_tiny_tweak.agent.title: Agent playing
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.baritone.tooltip: Every Baritone setting. Agents can change them too.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.baritone_log.toolti: Everything Baritone says, kept here instead of in chat.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.baritone_log.empty: Baritone has not said anything yet.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.baritone.reset.tool: Puts every setting back to MC Tiny Tweak's Baritone defaults.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.baritone.reset.conf: Every Baritone setting goes back to MC Tiny Tweak's defaults, or Baritone's own where the mod has none.
screen.mc_tiny_tweak.mcp.chat_wake.toolt: Notify subscribed MCP clients when another player speaks. Agents can also mute their own session. The connected app decides whether notifications wake its agent.
